text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Bahrain's Citi Islamic Investment Bank signs a $15 million loan facility with a Pakistani oil firm.
- Gulf Air's staff are to receive a pay rise of between three and five perecent from this month.
- Cabinet reviews new projects, including investment and tourism, to boost economy.
- Two committees from the private sector meet on Monday to discuss ways of providing more job opportunities for Bahrainis.
